headline: No business was conducted because there was not enough attendance for a quorum, so no items were decided.
summary: Not enough members were present for a quorum, so no business could be conducted. Chair Nancy Hendricks set the next meeting for 9/30/26 at 7 PM.
plain_text:
Leach Library Board of Trustees
Draft Meeting minutes
September 3, 2026 at 7:00 PM
Moose Hill Council Chambers, Town Hall, Londonderry NH
Members Present:
 Nancy Hendricks, Chair
 Beth Marrocco, Vice-Chair
 Erica Laue, Secretary
 Donna Plante, Interim Library Director
Members Absent:
 Jan McLaughlin, Trustee
 Maryam Mallick, Trustee
 Moira Ryan, Trustee
 Azra Palo, Treasurer
Call to Order: made at 7:02 PM by Chair Hendricks.
Due to the lack of quorum, no business can be conducted. Chair Hendricks set the next 
meeting for 9/30/26 at 7 PM.
Adjournment: 7:03 PM.
Minutes prepared by Secretary Laue.
